instructions.note: The prompt says "Do not give legal advice," which is a behavioral instruction rather than a structural control.

elements.name: Reply flow to authenticated requester's chat session

controls.name: Read only credential scoped to published policy index
Verified network layer egress deny except chat channel
Replies are bound to the authenticated requester's chat session
No approval gate because the agent only answers the authenticated requester
controls.decay_rationale: No approval gate is recommended because the current sink is limited to replying to the authenticated requester and present risk is already structurally severed.

controls.name: Model is pinned and changes require a change ticket

findings.title: Internal policy content can be returned to the authenticated requester, but the path is structurally limited to the same requester and no other egress exists

attack_path.note: Trusted authenticated requester asks a policy question
Agent reads the published HR policy index
Agent replies only to the same authenticated requester's chat session

threat_refs.name: Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation

forecast.watch_signal: Reassess if any new tool is added, if policy data scope widens beyond published internal policies, if session binding or network egress deny is removed, if the product purpose changes beyond policy Q&A, or if the pinned model version changes.

evidence.observation: The only declared tool is policy_search.search, which searches the published HR policy index.
Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session, the chat client does not render images or auto fetch links, and the agent has no other tools and no network egress.
Network egress is denied at the network layer and verified by a pen test, which structurally prevents other outbound channels.
The policy index holds only published policies with internal sensitivity, and the agent credential is read only and scoped to that index.

recommendations.action: Keep reply routing bound to the authenticated requester and preserve the verified network egress deny as release blocking controls for this agent.

rating.rationale: Present risk is low because the only meaningful path is a trusted employee question to internal policy read and reply back to the same authenticated requester. Structural controls sever broader disclosure paths: the agent has a read only credential scoped to the published policy index, reply routing is bound to the authenticated requester, and network egress is denied at the network layer and verified by pen test. No present untrusted source reaches a sensitive sink, there are no write, delete, execute, configure, spend, delegate, memory, or peer agent capabilities, and no forecast trigger considered changes the tier without changing the design itself.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration artifacts provided, not observed runtime behavior except where the runtime notes explicitly state verification such as the cited pen test.
No source code, IaC, or detailed runtime configuration was provided, so identity assurance, audit logging, and service resilience controls could not be fully verified.
Manual validation was applied against the provided schema and validation checklist because scripts could not be run in this environment.
